reviews.title: Worst business class flight I’ve ever experienced
reviews.text: I just want to warn anyone thinking about booking a business class flight on Donghai that they will likely regret it. After checking in, I inquired why I hadn’t received a pass for the lounge…and that’s where I got my first surprise. Apparently, they don’t participate in any of the lounge services, so customers are out of luck. Instead, they used the translate app to tell me that I would “enjoy the luxury in the air.” Uh, yeah, right. I get on the plane and they asked me what I’d like to drink, so I asked for a beer. Surprise number two! They don’t serve alcohol on the plane. Then, when I didn’t think it could get any worse, they brought out the meal service. I was APPALLED. I have gotten better food (this was a box with a roll, a banana, and a few peanuts..along with some mystery meat on a hamburger bun) on economy flights in third world countries. I get it now that this is a super economy company, but I didn’t when I booked it. Now I know (and so should everyone else). Never again. OH! And one more thing. The man across the row flew with no mask on, feet on the wall, music playing loudly through the external speaker, and his seat reclined the ENTIRE flight and apparently this wasn’t a problem for the flight attendants. Apparently trashy behavior is tolerated on Donghai as well. Ugh.
reviews.author: bjk127

reviews.title: Cancelled flight with no alternatives stranding Australian citizens in China at height of Coronavirus outbreak
reviews.text: Was due to fly home after the chinese new year. Arrived at the airport to find that Airline had made a commercial decision in light of the coronavirus reducing passenger numbers to cancel the flight between Darwin and Shenzhen, stranding ourselves and approximately 20 other people in China, with no offer of alternate flights, Accommodation, or anything other than a refund. Currently having to pay for $6000 of extra flights and accommodation to try and get myself and my family home. Discussed with Donghai personnel who seemed to indicate a refund as you've arrived at the airport was fair enough recompense for the drama of having to completely rebook flights, accommodation and make other changes at the last minute in the height of the coronavirus and associated travel restrictions. Will never fly Donghai again.
reviews.author: Fearless800683

reviews.title: Convenient and fast flight opening new places to travel
reviews.text: Only 5.5 hours to China compared to 4.45 hours to Singapore but you arrive to a different world. Shenzhen is a modern clean city where everything is about 1/3 of what it will cost in Singapore, including the airfares to Europe!
reviews.author: KonVat

reviews.title: At the airport a robot approached and scanned me
reviews.text: Arriving at the airport in Shenzhen, I was greeted by a robot who came up to me and I greeted him. He looked at me and went away. I guess the mission was safe The waiting room was fine, with each seat having its own charging port and service is in place Flight takeoff was delayed by over an hour. The airfare was a bargain price, the seat was comfortable, but the delay was long.
reviews.author: KodoDrummer

reviews.title: Trying to check-in on line
reviews.text: Donghai is a new carrier flying between Darwin and Shenzhen. Hubby heading off for a week. Very convenient route as it saves a layover of several hours via Singapore and cheaper too. Other reviews indicate food, comfort, cleanliness are all very good. On the ‘English’ website it is not possible to check-in on line. If you go to the Chinese website that functionality is offered (Thank you Google translate), however I wasn’t game enough to use it. There are also spelling errors on the website. Donghai could do with some technical help to make the English facing website more user friendly and accurate.
reviews.author: Teresa H

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: As far as flights go I have no complaints about the quality of Donghai airlines. The plane was clean and seats were comfortable. The only real problem was the over 1 hour delay, but I do believe it was beyond the airline's control.
reviews.author: Globetrottinggirl

reviews.title: bloody hopeless!!
reviews.text: tried to book Darwin to Shenzhen as the NT pollies had given this new flight a big wrap, not sure what it cost us in government subsidies. Two days to try and find out how to book, even our very good agent had problems with it. Finally got the booking, business class, to the payment part. Would only take mastercard so tried qantas mastercard, rejected as it was shown as "bank card " according to the booking. ok use the Westpac mastercard, still would not take it. Gave up in disgust and going to Thailand instead of China. All bookings done in about ten minutes and confirmed. suggest you give this mob a big miss.
reviews.author: Joan

reviews.title: Good service on the route from Beijing to Shenzhen
reviews.text: First time for me with Donghai. They are a small carrier based in Shenzhen. Generally my impression was very positive. plane was brand new and very tidy Boeing 737-800, service was good, food was good. Only gripe is that while they did show some TV shows, these were only in Chinese and that was the only form of in-flight entertainment. It is only a three-hour domestic flight but it is possible to offer a little more. I will recommend them though.
reviews.author: BJlawyer
